connectDescription: Choose where you use your agent, then add Koi as an MCP server.

chatgptStep: In ChatGPT, open Plugins, select Add custom MCP server, paste this URL and choose OAuth.
claudeStep: In Claude, add a custom remote connector and paste this URL.
cursorStep: In Cursor, open Customize, add an MCP server named koi and paste this URL.
oauthStep: When prompted, sign in to Koi and review the requested access.
commandStep: Run this command in your terminal.
codexSignInStep: Run codex mcp login koi, then sign in to Koi and review the requested access.
claudeCodeSignInStep: In Claude Code, run /mcp, then sign in to Koi and review the requested access.
tryStep: Ask your agent: “Who do answer engines recommend instead of my brand?”
